video_title: Celtics Trade Jaylen Brown for Giannis???

quotes.speaker: Brian Scalabrine
quotes.summary_phrase: Complexity of a potential Celtics trade for Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.excerpt: I don't think it's straight up. I think there's some other stuff involved.

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: Let me ask you, Scal, you brought up your Celtics and this hot take that's floating around: is Giannis for Jaylen Brown? First of all, who says no? Which side says no for that?

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Scalabrine
text_blocks.text: I think there's a lot of picks involved. I don't think it's straight up. I think there's some other stuff involved. It's not the Celtics' MO per se. They love shooting. They do want to build this thing around Jason Tatum and Jaylen Brown. If Jaylen Brown asked to leave, I think it would be more of a Tatum-centric team. Brad Stevens has made that trade for Derek White; he was better than people thought. Brad Stevens drafts these guys, they're better than we think. I have a feeling it would be more accentuating the idea of Jason Tatum being your best player if that were to happen.

quotes.speaker: Brian Scalabrine
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's comments on his favorite year of basketball
quotes.excerpt: I make of it that you should have been there on the stream because you would have asked the follow-up question.
quotes.quote: I make of it that you should have been there on the stream because you would have asked the follow-up question. What about the rest of them dudes doing? Just nodding in approval. Where is your follow-up? All right, that's cool. Let's compare it to the time you won it all and you won Finals MVP and Eastern Conference Finals MVP. Let's take a deeper dive into that. Why was it your favorite? Is it because the ball was in your hands? You think you can have it where the ball can be in your hands and Jason Tatum's hands? We're just going to nod in approval and be like, yeah, that's cool. This is the whole thing about the media and the players. I want my own platform. Can we get a follow-up?

quotes.speaker: Brian Scalabrine
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's All-NBA snub and the dominance of the top three
quotes.excerpt: No one's touching the immortal three: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Victor Wembanyama, and Nikola Jokic.
quotes.quote: With the whole backwards Luka Doncic going to Slovenia and all that stuff, I probably say no. But because you can't take Luka, I think Jason Tatum is well-deserved. They had the best record in the East. Jaylen Brown was ridiculous this year. But you look at Luka Doncic and you watch him play, it's hard not to put him up there. We're not arguing, let's be honest, no one's touching the immortal three: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Victor Wembanyama, and Nikola Jokic. So it's really Jason Tatum, Luka Doncic, and Jaylen Brown. When we decide first team, no one's touching the immortal three. The Luka-Slovenia thing was kind of up in the air. I would have picked him to do it because Luka kind of broke the rules, he didn't hit the 65-game mark. But that's actually up to the voters. Once they made Luka eligible, it's kind of hard not to put Luka Doncic on first team All-NBA.

quotes.speaker: Brian Scalabrine
quotes.summary_phrase: The necessity of high-paid big men for championship success
quotes.excerpt: No one wins with minimum bigs. No one. I'm not saying this year, go back in the history of the game.
quotes.quote: No one wins with minimum bigs. No one. I'm not saying this year, go back in the history of the game. No one wins with two bigs, your rotational bigs making minimum money. Most of those guys were all saying, that dude's making $20 million? Yeah, that dude's making $20 million. They did win with Jason Tatum and they won with Luka Garza, and that's to me, that's the hardest thing to do. There's a lot of ball, like, Luka is as skilled as anybody that's ever played, but you got to have bigs out there. If you're going to win, you got to have rim protection, you got to have size, you got to have this, and they got something out of dudes they found off the scrap heap, and that's really hard to do as a coach.
